# Land for sale

> 42.08 acres of Grade III chalk grassland located close to the development boundary of Salisbury City. SITUATION The land occupies a strategic semi-rural position close to the development boundary of Salisbury City, a principal settlement within southern Wiltshire. Access is directly off the A360 Devizes Road, an arterial route linking Salisbury to the A303, across Salisbury Plain to Devizes.
